issues.symptom: Main-process exception on closing an audible web page; playback continues until the modal is dismissed.
issues.reproduction: Real Electron AudioContext playback, isCurrentlyAudible=true, normal workspace close. Unmodified baseline raised the same isDestroyed TypeError in BrowserManager.publish.
issues.cause: The native View webContents accessor becomes unavailable during teardown, while audio/loading callbacks still run. Cleanup and callbacks depended on that accessor.
issues.fix: Retain stable WebContents handles, retire owned entries before closing them, ignore obsolete callbacks and defer destructive browser disposal until confirmed shutdown.

issues.symptom: Opening address suggestions in the right split freezes video in the left split.
issues.reproduction: Real Chromium canvas-stream video and requestVideoFrameCallback. Baseline frame count stopped at 11 while address suggestions covered another split.
issues.cause: LocationBar used the global capture-and-hide native overlay lifecycle, replacing every native web page with a still image.
issues.fix: Render only the dropdown in an owned transparent native view; preserve page bounds, identities, visibility and shell keyboard/IME focus.

issues.symptom: A second close prompt disappears after canceling and requesting shutdown again.
issues.cause: A queued close event from the previous HTMLDialogElement dismissal cancels the newly opened prompt.
issues.fix: Ignore the obsolete close event while the dialog is already open again.

checks.guiIsolation: Xvfb, private XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and D-Bus session, inherited Wayland socket removed.
checks.mediaFixtures: Synthetic Chromium canvas-stream video and AudioContext; no claim of testing a signed-in YouTube session.
scenarios: audible window close without main-process exception
close/quit cancellation preserves audio and confirmed exit completes
live video beside Markdown, web Reader and another web page
